title: Audit final rational bypass and prove receiving-bank separation
body:
**Independent scalar audit and scoped bank-span obstruction:** the last rational bypass in [PR #7786](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7786) preserves all 1,284 independent owners. Its half-payload recoding and new packet scale are uniquely forced in the specified two-parameter family. A sparse exact witness proves that its new value is outside the span of **all 901 retained receiving banks**, even with timing restrictions removed. **No new kappa** or complete admission is claimed.

Read the [proof and complete error law](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/189c882b6aa3d9adac3e30fe228446141a7c94f9/research/p104-final-bypass-audit/PROOF.md), [operator and separator certificate](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/189c882b6aa3d9adac3e30fe228446141a7c94f9/research/p104-final-bypass-audit/RESULT.json), [checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/189c882b6aa3d9adac3e30fe228446141a7c94f9/research/p104-final-bypass-audit/verify.py), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/189c882b6aa3d9adac3e30fe228446141a7c94f9/research/p104-final-bypass-audit/SOURCE-PINS.json) and [credits](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/189c882b6aa3d9adac3e30fe228446141a7c94f9/research/p104-final-bypass-audit/CREDITS.md).

The exact reverse delta reconstructs predecessor graph `1f1abdbd0601ad764ac254164e55dca39b6b83ac4ab0feb9904043639f291b28` from final graph `23b092d7e25b7e05caf76918e5956169113d6ea978d0939c95ce00f96595a67f`. Both complete forward operators and the separately transposed final operator pass: **1,648,656 coefficients per matrix**, including all 400 main fields and 884 independent helpers. Both declared schedules and every paid geometry are checked.

Let u be slot 80's 17-input payload, h the response to node 34002, and z the response to slot 80. Changing the recoding to `lambda*u` and the packet to `rho*u`, with all other forms fixed, gives the complete error `[(lambda-1/2)h+(rho-1)z]u`. The response minor at outputs 1282 and 488 has determinant -1. Thus only `lambda=1/2, rho=1` preserves the operator. Omitting slot 80 changes exactly 272 coefficients, including +1/2 at (488,22) and its adjoint counterpart.

The 901 receiving-bank forms have rank 901. A 16-entry vector annihilates every bank and gives `u(w)=-2`. Since slot 80 has terminal readers only, these retained bank forms do not change when it is omitted. No rational terminal-only reconstruction from this inventory can replace its contribution. Changed upstream words, extra paid deliveries and new charts are outside that obstruction.

| Paid action | Slot | Route | Grade |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| retire | 12 | 477 to 127 | 1 |
| retire | 95829 | 237 to 477 | 4 |
| insert | 80 | 237 to 127 | 5 |

The native paid count is 5,712 to 5,711, with all target ranks unchanged. The exact gain is `H1+H4-H5`, or `48(H1+H4-H5)` under the source's unchanged 48-call caller. This is positive for `H_r=r^t`, `0<t<1`. No complete root or ordinary/outer service is recalculated.

Use Python 3.12 and the standard library:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-final-bypass-audit
```

Both modes print this prefix and elapsed seconds:

```text
PASS_P104_FINAL_BYPASS_AUDIT 1648656 coefficients per operator 901 bank separator
```

Three full expansions use 47,736,551 integer coefficient products. Six parameter pairs are checked on complete input columns and separately transposed covectors. Five incorrect pairs fail the operator; the correct pair passes. False journal pins, wrong source charts and altered separators reject. All ten retained pins, normal/optimized replay, syntax/indentation, committed bytes/history/modes, export and sealed read-only Git-free replay pass. Hosted CI did not certify this package. The [plan job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44471779150/job/135382741039) failed in the shared `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`: the base guide names frontier6030 while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The log reports 760 tests, one failure and 24 skipped; package replay was skipped. This package changes no shared CI file. Local replay remains the scientific evidence.

Clear1nsight (@Clear1nsight) supplied the [source construction](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff6f1d8ab3fafb71ea12ccd943013d058c0f5847/research/p104-iterated-returns/README.md), [frozen graph](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff6f1d8ab3fafb71ea12ccd943013d058c0f5847/research/p104-iterated-returns/complex/WORD.json.gz), [delta](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff6f1d8ab3fafb71ea12ccd943013d058c0f5847/research/p104-iterated-returns/complex/POST-BIRTH-CHAIN-1.json.gz) and [full source notice](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff6f1d8ab3fafb71ea12ccd943013d058c0f5847/research/p104-iterated-returns/NOTICE). This builds on [PR #7781](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7781) and Ali Romman's [PR #7776](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7776). Ali Romman (@aliromman) supplied [PR #7777](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7777)'s [generic exact graph arithmetic](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0288431ab2ad0cccfbede0b57cd3edfb2679e0f6/research/p104-first-relay-repair/verify.py). Only those helpers are used; no PR #7786 engine or predecessor-specific suite is invoked. Original notices retain the full caller, physical, compiler and analytic lineage.

The preceding construction history, physical all-column suite, held-state erasure, full caller, ordinary compiler, precision, finite stock and outer services are not replayed. The source kappa is not recertified. No Lean, Docker, selected cold replay or independent human/formal acceptance is claimed. All five assumptions and the selected frontier remain unchanged.
